primary_title: Regulation of murine Tap1 and Lmp2 genes in macrophages by interferon gamma is mediated by STAT1 and IRF-1
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies cooperative STAT1 and IRF1 control of the shared Tap1/Lmp2 promoter during IFN-gamma stimulation of macrophages.
limitations_preserved: STAT1/IRF1-dependent promoter elements and macrophage expression establish a cooperative gene-activation edge; preserve the shared bidirectional promoter and do not infer TAP1 protein transport or a standalone STAT1 or IRF1 effect.

primary_title: Identification of novel TGF-beta/Smad gene targets in dermal fibroblasts using a combined cDNA microarray/promoter transactivation approach
decision_basis: Review-guided primary evidence identifies COL1A1 as a TGF-beta/Smad3-responsive fibroblast gene supported by promoter transactivation and Smad-dependent criteria.
limitations_preserved: Stringent primary promoter-transactivation criteria support bounded COL1A1 gene activation; preserve fibroblast/TGF-beta and Smad3-dependent context, and do not infer collagen translation, secretion, deposition or SCI effects automatically.
